properties.Degr_CN: 遗址被埋藏，部分遭到损毁
properties.Degr_EN: The site is buried and partially destroyed.
properties.Repa_CN: 近年开展了大规模的考古发掘和保护工程。
properties.Repa_EN: Large-scale archaeological excavations and protection projects have been carried out in recent years.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 明代菲律宾苏禄国东王访华期间病逝，葬于德州，是中菲友好交往的见证。
properties.Hist_EN: King Dong of the Philippine Sulu Kingdom in the Ming Dynasty died of illness during his visit to China and was buried in Dezhou, which is a witness to the friendly exchanges between China and the Philippines.
properties.Relae_CN: 苏禄王访华、明清时期的祭祀活动。
properties.Relae_EN: King Sulu's visit to China and the sacrificial activities in the Ming and Qing dynasties.
properties.Relap_CN: 苏禄东王（巴都葛叭答剌）、永乐帝
properties.Relap_EN: King Sulu Dong (Batu Ge Badala), Emperor Yongle
properties.Degr_CN: 部分出现风化，墓园整体保存良好
properties.Degr_EN: It has partially weathered, and the cemetery is well preserved.
properties.Repa_CN: 明清时期多次修缮，20 世纪 80 年代对墓园进行了修复。
properties.Repa_EN: It was repaired many times in the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the cemetery was restored in the 1980s of the 20th century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 明初东昌府（今聊城）的军事瞭望楼，后来成为文化地标。
properties.Hist_EN: It was a military watchtower of Dongchang Mansion (now Liaocheng) in the early Ming Dynasty and later became a cultural landmark.
properties.Relae_CN: 明清军事防御、文人雅集
properties.Relae_EN: Military defense in the Ming and Qing dynasties and gatherings of literati.
properties.Degr_EN: The structure is intact with some repairs done.
properties.Repa_CN: 明清时期多次维修，20 世纪 80 年代大修。
properties.Repa_EN: It has been repaired many times in the Ming and Qing dynasties and was overhauled in the 1980s of the 20th century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 清代山西、陕西商帮集资修建的商业会馆，兼具祭祀、议事功能。
properties.Hist_EN: It was a commercial guild built with funds raised by Shanxi and Shaanxi merchant groups in the Qing Dynasty, with both sacrificial and deliberative functions.
properties.Relae_CN: 清代商贸繁荣、运河文化
properties.Relae_EN: The prosperity of commerce and trade in the Qing Dynasty and canal culture.
properties.Degr_CN: 建筑保存较好，彩绘褪色
properties.Degr_EN: The buildings are well preserved, but the paintings have faded.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 90 年代修复彩绘、木构。
properties.Repa_EN: In the 1990s of the 20th century, the paintings and wooden structures were restored.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 京杭大运河重要水闸，明清时期调节运河水位的关键设施。
properties.Hist_EN: It was an important sluice gate of the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal and a key facility for regulating the water level of the canal in the Ming and Qing dynasties.
properties.Relae_EN: Canal transportation and water conservancy projects.
properties.Relap_EN: Water conservancy officials of the Ming and Qing dynasties
properties.Degr_CN: 遗址残存，部分结构清晰
properties.Degr_EN: The ruins remain, and some structures are clear.
properties.Repa_EN: Archaeological excavations and reinforcements were carried out in the 2010s.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 北宋佛教铁铸塔，原为隆兴寺附属建筑，现存铁塔为明代重建。
properties.Hist_EN: It is a Buddhist iron-cast pagoda of the Northern Song Dynasty, originally an auxiliary building of Longxing Temple; the existing iron tower was rebuilt in the Ming Dynasty.
properties.Relae_EN: The spread of Buddhism and the reconstruction in the Ming Dynasty.
properties.Degr_EN: There is iron rust on the tower, but the structure is stable.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 90 年代除锈加固。
properties.Repa_EN: Rust removal and reinforcement were carried out in the 1990s of the 20th century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 传为《水浒传》中武松打虎之地，实际是新石器至商周时期的文化遗址。
properties.Hist_EN: It is said to be the place where Wu Song fought the tiger in Water Margin, but it is actually a cultural site from the Neolithic Age to the Shang and Zhou dynasties.
properties.Relae_EN: The story of Water Margin and archaeological excavations.
properties.Relap_CN: 武松（文学人物）、考古学家
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 80 年代修建保护设施，近年进行环境整治。
properties.Repa_EN: Conservation facilities were built in the 1980s of the 20th century, and environmental improvement was carried out in recent years.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 新石器时代文化遗址（约公元前 4000 年），大汶口文化的命名地。
properties.Hist_EN: It is a Neolithic cultural site (c. 4000 BC) and the naming place of Dawenkou culture.
properties.Relae_EN: Prehistoric settlements and archaeological research.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪进行多次考古发掘，建设遗址公园。
properties.Repa_EN: Many archaeological excavations were carried out in the 20th century, and a site park was built.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 明清时期大汶河上的交通要道，石板结构。
properties.Hist_EN: It was a traffic artery on the Dawen River during the Ming and Qing dynasties, with a stone slab structure.
properties.Relae_EN: Ancient transportation and water conservancy projects.
properties.Repa_EN: Partial restoration was carried out in the early 21st century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 包含宋至明清时期的佛教摩崖石刻，有佛像、经文等。
properties.Hist_EN: It includes Buddhist cliff carvings from the Song Dynasty to the Ming and Qing dynasties, such as Buddha statues and scriptures.
properties.Relae_EN: The spread of Buddhism and folk beliefs.
properties.Degr_EN: It has partially weathered and peeled off.
properties.Repa_CN: 近年清理杂草，未进行大规模修缮。
properties.Repa_EN: Weeds have been cleaned up in recent years, and no large-scale repairs have been carried out.

properties.Heri_EN: Stone Carvings of Xiao Daheng Cemetery
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 明代兵部尚书萧大亨墓前的石刻，石象生、牌坊雕刻精美。
properties.Hist_EN: In front of the tomb of Xiao Daheng, the Minister of War of the Ming Dynasty, the stone statues and archways are exquisitely carved.
properties.Relae_EN: The funeral system for officials in the Ming Dynasty.
properties.Degr_EN: The stone carvings have weathered and are partially incomplete.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 90 年代修复牌坊。
properties.Repa_EN: The archway was restored in the 1990s of the 20th century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 泰山祭祀的主庙，始建于汉代，历代帝王在此举行封禅大典。
properties.Hist_EN: It is the main temple for Taishan sacrifices, built in the Han Dynasty, and emperors of successive dynasties held Fengshan ceremonies (imperial ceremonies to worship mountains) here.
properties.Relae_EN: Emperors' Fengshan ceremonies and Taoist activities.
properties.Relap_EN: Emperor Qin Shi Huang, Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty, Emperor Qianlong
properties.Degr_CN: 主体完好，部分古树老化
properties.Degr_EN: The main body is intact, and some ancient trees are aging.
properties.Repa_CN: 历代均有重修，20 世纪进行大规模修缮。
properties.Repa_EN: It has been rebuilt by successive dynasties and underwent large-scale repairs in the 20th century.

properties.Heri_EN: Yanzi Temple and Yanlin in Ningyang
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 祭祀孔子弟子颜回的场所，元代始建，墓园树木高耸。
properties.Hist_EN: It is used to worship Yan Hui, a disciple of Confucius. It was first built in the Yuan Dynasty, and the cemetery has towering trees.
properties.Relae_EN: The inheritance of Confucian culture.
properties.Relap_EN: Yan Hui, Confucian scholars of all dynasties
properties.Repa_EN: The main hall was restored at the beginning of the 21st century.

properties.Heri_EN: Stone Carvings of Jiaxiang Wu Tomb Group
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 东汉武氏家族墓石刻（武梁祠），画像石艺术珍品。
properties.Hist_EN: It refers to the stone carvings of the Wu family tomb (Wuliang Temple) in the Eastern Han Dynasty, which are treasures of portrait stone art.
properties.Relae_CN: 汉代丧葬艺术、金石学研究
properties.Relae_EN: Han Dynasty funeral art and epigraphy research.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪建设保护大厅，定期维护。
properties.Repa_EN: A protection hall was built in the 20th century, and regular maintenance is carried out.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 北宋铁铸塔，原属崇觉寺，现存铁塔为明代重建。
properties.Hist_EN: It is an iron-cast pagoda of the Northern Song Dynasty, originally belonging to Chongjue Temple; the existing iron tower was rebuilt in the Ming Dynasty.
properties.Relae_EN: The spread of Buddhism and metal craftsmanship.
properties.Degr_EN: There is iron rust on the tower.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 80 年代加固塔基。
properties.Repa_EN: The pagoda foundation was strengthened in the 1980s of the 20th century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 明清时期伊斯兰清真寺，运河沿岸回族宗教中心。
properties.Hist_EN: It is an Islamic mosque of the Ming and Qing dynasties and a religious center for the Hui people along the canal.
properties.Relae_CN: 回族宗教活动、运河文化交流
properties.Relae_EN: Hui religious activities and cultural exchanges along the canal.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 90 年代修复大殿。
properties.Repa_EN: The main hall was restored in the 1990s of the 20th century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 隋唐至明清时期的水利工程，调节泗水、沂河水系。
properties.Hist_EN: It is a water conservancy project from the Sui and Tang dynasties to the Ming and Qing dynasties, regulating the Surabaya and Yihe river systems.
properties.Relae_EN: Ancient water conservancy and transportation.
properties.Relap_EN: Craftsmen of the Sui and Tang dynasties
properties.Degr_EN: The dam body is partially damaged.
properties.Repa_CN: 近年进行考古发掘并局部修复。
properties.Repa_EN: Archaeological excavations have been carried out and partial restoration has been done in recent years.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 唐代始建的塔，经多次重建，现为明代砖塔。
properties.Hist_EN: The pagoda was first built in the Tang Dynasty and has been rebuilt many times; it is now a brick pagoda of the Ming Dynasty.
properties.Relae_EN: Buddhist architecture and reconstruction in successive dynasties.
properties.Degr_EN: The pagoda body is tilted and partially damaged.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 80 年代加固塔基。
properties.Repa_EN: The pagoda foundation was strengthened in the 1980s of the 20th century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 宋代石拱桥，横跨泗水，结构精巧。
properties.Hist_EN: It is a stone arch bridge of the Song Dynasty, spanning the Surabaya River with an exquisite structure.
properties.Relae_EN: Ancient bridge engineering.
properties.Degr_EN: The bridge deck is worn, but the structure is stable.
properties.Repa_EN: The guardrails were repaired in the early 21st century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 唐代始建，宋代重建，现呈明清风格。
properties.Hist_EN: The pagoda was first built in the Tang Dynasty, rebuilt in the Song Dynasty, and now has the style of the Ming and Qing dynasties.
properties.Relae_EN: Buddhist culture and reconstruction in past dynasties.
properties.Degr_EN: The pagoda body is well preserved.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 90 年代修复塔檐。
properties.Repa_EN: The eaves of the pagoda were repaired in the 1990s of the 20th century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 隋代始建，宋代重建，地宫出土舍利等文物。
properties.Hist_EN: The pagoda was first built in the Sui Dynasty and rebuilt in the Song Dynasty; cultural relics such as Buddhist relics were unearthed from the underground palace.
properties.Relae_CN: 供奉佛教舍利、考古发现
properties.Relae_EN: Enshrinement of Buddhist relics and archaeological discoveries.
properties.Repa_CN: 2008 年修复地宫并对外开放。
properties.Repa_EN: The underground palace was restored and opened to the public in 2008.

properties.Heri_EN: Former Site of the Taierzhuang War
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 1938 年抗日战争中台儿庄战役的主战场，中国军队的重大胜利之地。
properties.Hist_EN: It was the main battlefield of the Battle of Taierzhuang in the 1938 War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, a major victory for the Chinese army.
properties.Relae_EN: The Battle of Taierzhuang.
properties.Degr_CN: 部分建筑损毁后已修复
properties.Degr_EN: Some buildings were damaged and have been restored.
properties.Repa_CN: 2000 年后重建部分战场遗址。
properties.Repa_EN: Some battlefield sites were rebuilt in the 2000s.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 南北朝至元代的北方瓷窑遗址，以青瓷为主。
properties.Hist_EN: It is a northern porcelain kiln site from the Northern and Southern Dynasties to the Yuan Dynasty, mainly producing celadon.
properties.Relae_EN: Ancient ceramic production.
properties.Degr_EN: The remains of the kiln site exist.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪进行考古发掘，建设保护棚。
properties.Repa_EN: Archaeological excavations were carried out in the 20th century, and protective sheds were built.

properties.Heri_EN: Former Site of Zhongxing Coal Mining Company
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 近代中国最大的民族资本煤矿（1878 年创办），工业遗产。
properties.Hist_EN: It was the largest national capital coal mine in modern China (founded in 1878) and an industrial heritage.
properties.Relae_CN: 近代工业发展、抗日战争时期损毁
properties.Relae_EN: The development of modern industry and destruction during the Anti-Japanese War.
properties.Relap_EN: Zhang Lianfen, entrepreneurs of the Republic of China
properties.Repa_EN: The office buildings were restored in the early 21st century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 唐代始建，明代重建，砖石结构。
properties.Hist_EN: The pagoda was first built in the Tang Dynasty and rebuilt in the Ming Dynasty, with a masonry structure.
properties.Relae_EN: Buddhist architecture and local symbols.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 80 年代进行加固。
properties.Repa_EN: Reinforcement was carried out in the 1980s of the 20th century.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 北宋时期的塔，原属永丰寺，现存为砖塔。
properties.Hist_EN: It is a pagoda of the Northern Song Dynasty, originally belonging to Yongfeng Temple; the existing pagoda is a brick pagoda.
properties.Relae_EN: Buddhist culture.
properties.Degr_EN: The pagoda body is generally preserved.
properties.Repa_EN: Partial maintenance has been carried out in recent years.

properties.Heri_EN: Ancient Fiber Road of the Eastern Zhejiang Canal
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 唐代始建，用于拉船纤夫行走，是运河航运的重要设施。
properties.Hist_EN: Founded in the Tang Dynasty, it was used for pulling ship fibers and was an important facility for canal transportation.
properties.Relae_EN: Ancient transportation and trade exchanges.
properties.Relap_EN: Local officials and fiber workers of the Tang Dynasty
properties.Degr_EN: It has partially weathered and partially fractured.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 80 年代修复，2014 年加固修缮。
properties.Repa_EN: It was repaired in the 1980s of the 20th century and reinforced and repaired again in 2014.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 宋代古桥，横跨运河，是古代交通要道。
properties.Hist_EN: It is an ancient bridge of the Song Dynasty, spanning the canal and serving as an ancient transportation artery.
properties.Relae_CN: 宋代桥梁建造技术发展
properties.Relae_EN: The development of bridge construction technology in the Song Dynasty.
properties.Relap_EN: Craftsmen and local officials of the Song Dynasty
properties.Degr_CN: 桥体保存良好，局部石材风化
properties.Degr_EN: The bridge body is well preserved, and the local stone has weathered.
properties.Repa_CN: 2005 年修复桥面，2018 年加固桥墩。
properties.Repa_EN: The bridge deck was repaired in 2005 and the piers were strengthened in 2018.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 清代石拱桥，连接运河两岸，具有较高艺术价值。
properties.Hist_EN: It is a stone arch bridge of the Qing Dynasty, connecting both sides of the canal and having high artistic value.
properties.Relae_EN: Folk bridge construction in the Qing Dynasty.
properties.Relap_EN: Squires and craftsmen of the Qing Dynasty
properties.Degr_CN: 结构完好，部分雕刻磨损
properties.Degr_EN: The structure is intact, and some carvings are worn.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 90 年代修复，2010 年河道清淤时加固。
properties.Repa_EN: It was repaired in the 1990s and strengthened when the river was cleared in 2010.

properties.Coun_CN: 临平区、拱墅区、上城区、秀洲区、南湖区
properties.Coun_EN: Linping District, Gongshu District, Shangcheng District, Xiuzhou District, Nanhu District
properties.Heri_CN: 江南运河嘉兴 - 杭州段
properties.Heri_EN: Jiaxing-Hangzhou Section of the Jiangnan Canal
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 春秋时期开凿，隋代纳入大运河体系，是运河航运的主干道。
properties.Hist_EN: Excavated in the Spring and Autumn Period, it was included in the Grand Canal system in the Sui Dynasty and became a main route for canal transportation.
properties.Relae_CN: 隋唐大运河贯通、明清鼎盛
properties.Relae_EN: The connection of the Grand Canal in the Sui and Tang dynasties, and its prosperity in the Ming and Qing dynasties.
properties.Relap_EN: Emperor Yang of the Sui Dynasty and transport officials of successive dynasties
properties.Degr_CN: 部分河道淤积，沿岸设施老化
properties.Degr_EN: Some sections of the river were silted up, and the coastal facilities were in poor condition.
properties.Repa_CN: 2010 年清淤，2014 年纳入大运河申遗保护。
properties.Repa_EN: Desilting was carried out in 2010, and it was included in the Grand Canal application for protection in 2014.

properties.Coun_EN: Xiaoshan District, Keqiao District, Yuecheng District
properties.Heri_CN: 浙东运河杭州萧山 - 绍兴段
properties.Heri_EN: Hangzhou Xiaoshan-Shaoxing Section of the Eastern Zhejiang Canal
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 春秋时期开凿，历代疏浚，是连接钱塘江与曹娥江的重要水道。
properties.Hist_EN: Excavated during the Spring and Autumn Period, it was dredged in successive dynasties and became an important waterway connecting the Qiantang River and the Cao'e River.
properties.Relae_CN: 越国水利工程、宋代航运繁荣
properties.Relae_EN: Water conservancy projects of the Yue State and the prosperity of shipping in the Song Dynasty.
properties.Relap_EN: Fan Zhongyan (once presided over the dredging work)
properties.Degr_CN: 河道保存良好，部分古闸损坏
properties.Degr_EN: The river channel is well preserved, and some ancient gates are damaged.
properties.Repa_CN: 2008 年修复古闸，2012 年整治环境。
properties.Repa_EN: The ancient gates were repaired in 2008 and the environment was renovated in 2012.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 南宋古桥，为纪念抗元义士唐钰（号桂芳）而命名。
properties.Hist_EN: It is an ancient bridge of the Southern Song Dynasty, named in honor of Tang Yu, a righteous man who resisted the Yuan Dynasty (known as Guifang).
properties.Relae_EN: The anti-Yuan struggle in the Southern Song Dynasty.
properties.Relap_EN: Tang Yu, patriots of the Southern Song Dynasty
properties.Degr_CN: 桥体稳定，部分石雕损坏
properties.Degr_EN: The bridge body is stable, and some stone carvings are damaged.
properties.Repa_CN: 1986 年修复，2015 年加固栏杆。
properties.Repa_EN: It was repaired in 1986 and the railing was strengthened in 2015.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 清代私家园林，体现运河沿岸富商生活。
properties.Hist_EN: It is a private garden of the Qing Dynasty, reflecting the life of wealthy merchants along the canal.
properties.Relae_CN: 清末民初丝绸贸易繁荣、高氏家族（丝绸商人）
properties.Relae_EN: The prosperity of the silk trade in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, and the Gao family (silk merchants).
properties.Degr_CN: 建筑老化，园林部分废弃
properties.Degr_EN: The building was aging and the garden was partially abandoned.
properties.Repa_CN: 2003 年修复主体建筑，2020 年修缮园林景观。
properties.Repa_EN: The main building was restored in 2003 and the garden landscape was repaired in 2020.

properties.Heri_CN: 浙东运河上虞 - 余姚段
properties.Heri_EN: Shangyu-Yuyao Section of the Eastern Zhejiang Canal
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 东汉时期开凿，是浙东运河的核心段，以水利设施闻名。
properties.Hist_EN: Excavated during the Eastern Han Dynasty, it is the core section of the Eastern Zhejiang Canal and is famous for its water conservancy facilities.
properties.Relae_CN: 东汉马臻修建鉴湖、唐宋航运发展
properties.Relae_EN: Ma Zhen of the Eastern Han Dynasty built Jianhu Lake and the development of shipping in the Tang and Song dynasties.
properties.Relap_EN: Ma Zhen (a hydraulic engineer of the Eastern Han Dynasty)
properties.Repa_CN: 2016 年清理河道，2019 年修复坝体遗迹。
properties.Repa_EN: The river channel was cleaned up in 2016 and the remains of the dam were restored in 2019.

properties.Coun_CN: 余姚市、海曙区、江北区、镇海区
properties.Coun_EN: Yuyao City, Haishu District, Jiangbei District, Zhenhai District
properties.Heri_EN: Ningbo Section of the Eastern Zhejiang Canal
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 唐代形成，连接余姚与宁波三江口，是海上丝绸之路的起点之一。
properties.Hist_EN: Formed in the Tang Dynasty, it connects Yuyao and Sanjiangkou of Ningbo and is one of the starting points of the Maritime Silk Road.
properties.Relae_CN: 唐宋海外贸易、近代通商口岸开放
properties.Relae_EN: Maritime trade in the Tang and Song dynasties and the opening of modern trade ports.
properties.Relap_CN: 吴越国钱镠、唐代漕运使
properties.Relap_EN: Qian Liao of the Wuyue State, grain transportation envoys of the Tang Dynasty
properties.Degr_CN: 河道完好，沿岸码头遗址留存
properties.Degr_EN: The river channel is intact, and the coastal wharf sites exist.
properties.Repa_CN: 2011 年整治码头遗址，2014 年申遗保护。
properties.Repa_EN: The wharf sites were renovated in 2011 and it was applied for heritage protection in 2014.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 甬江、奉化江、余姚江三江交汇处，唐宋以来为航运枢纽。
properties.Hist_EN: It is the confluence of the Yongjiang River, Fenghua River and Yuyao River, and has been a shipping hub since the Tang and Song dynasties.
properties.Relae_CN: 宋代市舶司设立、近代五口通商
properties.Relae_EN: The Maritime Department was established in the Song Dynasty and the five-port trade in modern times.
properties.Relap_EN: Wang Anshi (former magistrate of Yin County)
properties.Degr_CN: 现代建设覆盖部分历史遗迹
properties.Degr_EN: Modern construction has covered some historical relics.
properties.Repa_CN: 2000 年后多次环境整治，保留历史风貌。
properties.Repa_EN: Many environmental renovations have been made since 2000 to preserve the historical style.

properties.Heri_EN: Yaojiang Water Conservancy and Shipping Facilities
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 宋代以来修建的堰坝、水闸，调节水位以利航运。
properties.Hist_EN: Weirs and sluice gates built since the Song Dynasty adjust the water level to facilitate shipping.
properties.Relae_EN: The innovation of water conservancy technology in the Song Dynasty.
properties.Relap_EN: Wang Anshi, magistrate of Yin County in the Northern Song Dynasty
properties.Degr_CN: 部分设施废弃，结构尚存
properties.Degr_EN: Some facilities were abandoned, but their structures still exist.
properties.Repa_CN: 2017 年进行考古发掘，2021 年修复部分水闸。
properties.Repa_EN: Archaeological excavations were carried out in 2017 and some sluice gates were repaired in 2021.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 南宋时期设立的水文观测碑，用于监测运河水位，是世界上最早的水文标志之一。
properties.Hist_EN: It is a hydrological survey monument erected in the Southern Song Dynasty, used to monitor the water level of the canal, and is one of the earliest hydrological landmarks in the world.
properties.Relae_EN: The scientific management of water conservancy in the Southern Song Dynasty.
properties.Relap_EN: Wu Qian (Promoter of Eastern Zhejiang in the Southern Song Dynasty)
properties.Degr_EN: The stele is complete, but the handwriting is blurred.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 80 年代加装保护罩，2013 年修缮碑亭。
properties.Repa_EN: A protective cover was installed in the 1980s, and the stele pavilion was repaired in 2013.

properties.Heri_EN: Nanxun Section of the Jiangnan Canal
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 明清时期因丝绸贸易繁荣，沿岸富商修建众多建筑。
properties.Hist_EN: During the Ming and Qing dynasties, due to the prosperity of the silk trade, many merchants built buildings along the coast.
properties.Relae_CN: 近代湖丝出口鼎盛、南浔 “四象八牛” 丝商
properties.Relae_EN: The peak of lake silk export in modern times and the "four elephants and eight cows" silk merchants in Nanxun.
properties.Relap_CN: 南浔 “四象八牛” 丝商
properties.Relap_EN: The "four elephants and eight cows" silk merchants in Nanxun
properties.Degr_CN: 河道保存良好，部分建筑经整治
properties.Degr_EN: The river channel is well preserved, and some buildings have been renovated.
properties.Repa_CN: 2000 年后修复古镇，2014 年纳入大运河申遗。
properties.Repa_EN: The ancient town was restored after 2000 and included in the Grand Canal application in 2014.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 清末南浔丝商集资修建，见证近代民族工业发展。
properties.Hist_EN: Built with funds raised by Nanxun silk merchants in the late Qing Dynasty, it witnessed the development of modern national industry.
properties.Relae_EN: The modern industrial salvation movement.
properties.Relap_EN: Liu Yong (leader of Nanxun silk merchants)
properties.Degr_CN: 建筑结构完好，内部陈设缺失
properties.Degr_EN: The building structure is intact, but the internal furnishings are missing.
properties.Repa_CN: 2008 年修复主体，2016 年改设博物馆。
properties.Repa_EN: The main body was restored in 2008 and converted into a museum in 2016.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 19 世纪末至 20 世纪初的南浔丝商住宅，中西合璧风格。
properties.Hist_EN: It refers to the residences of Nanxun silk merchants from the late 19th century to the early 20th century, combining Chinese and Western styles.
properties.Relae_EN: Modern cultural exchanges between China and the West.
properties.Relap_EN: Zhang Jingjiang (descendant of Nanxun silk merchants)
properties.Degr_CN: 部分建筑损坏，整体风格保留
properties.Degr_EN: Some buildings were damaged, but the overall style was retained.
properties.Repa_CN: 2010 年后分批修缮，部分改为文化场馆。
properties.Repa_EN: It was repaired in batches after 2010, and some were converted into cultural venues.

properties.Heri_EN: Weir Dam Site on Both Sides of the Cao'e River
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 东汉至清代修建的一组堰坝，用于防洪、灌溉。
properties.Hist_EN: It is a group of weirs built from the Eastern Han Dynasty to the Qing Dynasty for flood control and irrigation.
properties.Relae_CN: 东汉鉴湖工程、唐宋水利拓展
properties.Relae_EN: The Jianhu Project of the Eastern Han Dynasty and the expansion of water conservancy in the Tang and Song dynasties.
properties.Relap_CN: 马臻（东汉）、贺知章（唐代疏浚）
properties.Relap_EN: Ma Zhen (Eastern Han Dynasty), He Zhizhang (dredging in the Tang Dynasty)
properties.Degr_CN: 遗址残缺，部分埋于地下
properties.Degr_EN: The site is incomplete and partially buried underground.
properties.Repa_CN: 2018 年进行考古调查，2022 年局部展示修复。
properties.Repa_EN: An archaeological survey was conducted in 2018 and partial display restoration was carried out in 2022.

properties.Heri_CN: 虞余运河水利航运设施
properties.Heri_EN: Water Conservancy and Shipping Facilities of the Yuyu Canal
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 春秋时期水利工程遗迹，包含堰门、斗门等。
properties.Hist_EN: It is the remains of a water conservancy project from the Spring and Autumn Period, including weir gates and bucket gates.
properties.Relae_CN: 越国水利建设、宋代运河改造
properties.Relae_EN: Water conservancy construction in the Yue State and canal reform in the Song Dynasty.
properties.Relap_EN: Fan Zhongyan (governed Taihu Lake in the Northern Song Dynasty)
properties.Degr_CN: 设施老化，部分功能废弃
properties.Degr_EN: The facilities are aging and some functions are abandoned.
properties.Repa_CN: 2015 年清理河道，2020 年修复部分古闸。
properties.Repa_EN: The river channel was cleaned up in 2015 and some ancient gates were repaired in 2020.

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 汇集历代石刻，以《瘗鹤铭》闻名
properties.Hist_EN: Collects stone carvings of successive dynasties, famous for "Epitaph of the Buried Crane"
properties.Relae_CN: 清康熙年间建宝墨亭保护
properties.Relae_EN: Built Baomo Pavilion for protection in the Kangxi period of the Qing Dynasty
properties.Relap_EN: Mi Fu, Lu You and other inscribers
properties.Degr_EN: Some inscriptions are weathered and broken
properties.Repa_EN: Built a new museum for moisture prevention in 2002

properties.Heri_EN: Former Site of the British Consulate in Zhenjiang
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings in Modern Times
properties.Hist_CN: 第二次鸦片战争后设立
properties.Hist_EN: Established after the Second Opium War
properties.Relae_EN: Recovered by the Northern Expeditionary Army in 1927
properties.Degr_EN: The main building is well preserved
properties.Repa_EN: Converted into a museum and maintained in 1959

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 佛教过街石塔，全国唯一
properties.Hist_EN: Buddhist street-crossing stone pagoda, the only one in China
properties.Relae_EN: Remains of Yuan Dynasty Lamaist architecture
properties.Degr_EN: Partial settlement of the pagoda base
properties.Repa_EN: Overall lifting and reinforcement in 1999

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 吴国军事城堡
properties.Hist_EN: Military castle of the Wu State
properties.Relae_EN: Unearthed bronze swords and pottery
properties.Degr_EN: The rammed earth of the city wall is eroded by wind and rain
properties.Repa_EN: Covered protection in 2010

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Cons_EN: Western Zhou Dynasty to Spring and Autumn Period
properties.Hist_CN: 吴国早期都城
properties.Hist_EN: Early capital of the Wu State
properties.Relae_EN: Confirmed the city wall through archaeology in 2007
properties.Repa_EN: Built a protection and exhibition area in 2015

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Cons_EN: Three Kingdoms and Eastern Jin Dynasties
properties.Hist_CN: 孙权所建治所，有 “三国东吴第一城” 之称
properties.Hist_EN: Built by Sun Quan as his seat of government, known as "the first city of Eastern Wu in the Three Kingdoms"
properties.Relae_EN: Place for negotiating the marriage between Sun and Liu
properties.Degr_EN: Only the rammed earth at the south gate remains
properties.Repa_EN: Built a site park in 2004

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 吴国皇室贵族陵墓群
properties.Hist_EN: Mausoleum group of the royal family and nobles of the Wu State
properties.Relae_EN: Excavated the "Mother and Child Mound" in 1982
properties.Repa_EN: Protected the mound in 2010

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 宜侯夨簋出土地
properties.Hist_EN: Place where the Yihou Zun was unearthed
properties.Relae_EN: Unearthed Wu bronze wares in 1954
properties.Degr_CN: 墓地被平毁，文物藏博物馆
properties.Degr_EN: The cemetery was leveled, and the relics are stored in the museum
properties.Repa_EN: No original site remains

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 原为石塔，明代改铸铁塔
properties.Hist_EN: Originally a stone pagoda, recast into an iron pagoda in the Ming Dynasty
properties.Relae_CN: 唐代李德裕建石塔；明代重建铁塔
properties.Relae_EN: Li Deyu of the Tang Dynasty built a stone pagoda; rebuilt the iron pagoda in the Ming Dynasty
properties.Degr_CN: 太平天国时期受损三层
properties.Degr_EN: Damaged three levels during the Taiping Rebellion
properties.Repa_EN: Restored the ruined pagoda in 1960

properties.Heri_CN: 明中都皇故城及皇陵石刻
properties.Heri_EN: Ming Zhongdu Imperial City Ruins and Imperial Mausoleum Stone Carvings
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 古建筑及历史纪念建筑物
properties.Hist_CN: 朱元璋为父母、兄嫂所建皇陵，元至正二十六年（1366 年）始建，明洪武十二年（1379 年）建成，规模宏大，尤以神道石刻群（洪武二年后雕刻）艺术价值极高，虽非帝陵但 “宫阙壮丽”，与南
properties.Hist_EN: The imperial mausoleum built by Zhu Yuanzhang for his parents, elder brother and sister-in-law, constructed in the 26th year of the Yuan Dynasty (1366) and completed in the 12th year of the Hongwu era (1379). It is magnificent, especially the Shinto ston
properties.Relae_CN: 明末焚毁：与中都城同遭张献忠起义军焚毁，地表木构建筑无存，仅留石刻、碑亭等石构
properties.Relae_EN: Burned at the end of the Ming Dynasty: Destroyed by Zhang Xianzhong's rebel army together with Zhongdu City, all above-ground wooden buildings were lost, leaving only stone carvings, stele pavilions and other stone structures
properties.Relap_CN: 朱元璋父朱世珍（追尊仁祖淳皇帝）、母陈氏（淳皇后）
properties.Relap_EN: Zhu Shizhen (father of Zhu Yuanzhang, posthumously Emperor Renzu Chun), Chen (mother of Zhu Yuanzhang, posthumously Empress Chun)
properties.Degr_CN: 陵寝木构宫殿建筑无存
properties.Degr_EN: All wooden palace buildings of the mausoleum are lost
properties.Repa_CN: 近年文物保护部门对石刻进行防风化处理及局部加固
properties.Repa_EN: In recent years, the cultural relics protection department has carried out weatherproof treatment and local reinforcement on the stone carvings

properties.Heri_CN: 琅琊山摩崖题刻及碑刻
properties.Heri_EN: Langya Mountain Cliff Carvings and Inscriptions
properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 主要为唐至民国时期题刻，以宋代为多，琅琊山因欧阳修《醉翁亭记》闻名，成为文人官员访古题刻胜地，这些题刻是研究古代书法、文学、历史及佛教文化的珍贵实物资料
properties.Hist_EN: Mainly dating from the Tang Dynasty to the Republic of China, especially the Song Dynasty. Langya Mountain became famous for Ouyang Xiu's "The Drunken Pavilion" and became a resort for literati and officials to visit and inscribe. These inscriptions are
properties.Relae_CN: 北宋庆历六年（1046 年）欧阳修作《醉翁亭记》；苏轼手书题刻（现存复制品）；历代文人到访题咏
properties.Relae_EN: In the 6th year of the Northern Song Dynasty (1046), Ouyang Xiu wrote "The Drunken Pavilion"; Su Shi's handwritten inscription (now a copy); literati of all dynasties visited and wrote poems
properties.Relap_CN: 欧阳修、苏轼、历代文人官员及僧人
properties.Relap_EN: Ouyang Xiu, Su Shi, literati officials and monks of all dynasties
properties.Degr_CN: 中度损坏（自然风化、酸雨侵蚀、历史人为破坏所致）
properties.Degr_EN: Moderate damage (caused by natural weathering, acid rain erosion and historical man-made destruction)
properties.Repa_CN: 持续保护，包括建碑亭、设防护栏、定期清理植被、数字拓印存档；珍贵题刻常以玻璃罩或护栏物理隔离
properties.Repa_EN: Continuous protection measures, including building stele pavilions, installing protective railings, regularly cleaning vegetation, conducting digital rubbing and archiving; precious inscriptions are often isolated by glass covers or railings

properties.Prot_CN: 全国重点文物保护单位
properties.Prot_EN: National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings in Modern Times
properties.Hist_CN: 位于滁州市凤阳县，1978 年 18 位农民冒险以 “托孤” 形式在土地承包责任书上按红手印，实行 “大包干”，创造 “小岗精神”，开启中国农村改革序幕
properties.Hist_EN: Located in Fengyang County, Chuzhou City. In 1978, 18 farmers risked signing a land contract with red handprints ("entrusting orphans"), implemented the "household contract responsibility system", created the "Xiaogang Spirit" and initiated China's rural
properties.Relae_CN: 1978 年 “大包干” 事件（中国农村改革主要标志）
properties.Relae_EN: The 1978 "household contract" incident (a major symbol of China's rural reform)
properties.Relap_CN: 严宏昌、严俊昌、关友江等 18 位小岗村村民
properties.Relap_EN: Yan Hongchang, Yan Junchang, Guan Youjiang and other 18 villagers of Xiaogang Village
properties.Degr_CN: 作为改革开放标志性纪念遗址，核心文物（如当年契约）及旧址均精心保护，当年茅草屋等建筑已维护复原
properties.Degr_EN: As a landmark memorial site of reform and opening up, its core cultural relics (such as the deed signed that year) and the old site have been carefully protected. The thatched houses and other buildings of that year have been maintained and restored
properties.Repa_CN: 旧址开放为 “大包干纪念馆” 及爱国主义教育基地，定期维护修缮建筑，确保原始历史风貌留存
properties.Repa_EN: The old site was opened as the "Household Contract Memorial Hall" and a patriotic education base, with regular maintenance to preserve the original historical appearance

properties.Heri_CN: 九里山白云洞古生物化石遗址
properties.Heri_EN: Paleontological Fossil Site of Baiyun Cave in Jiulishan
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 含古脊椎动物化石的石灰岩溶洞。
properties.Hist_EN: A limestone cave containing paleovertebrate fossils.
properties.Relae_EN: Fossils were found in 1994.
properties.Degr_CN: 文革时期寺庙被毁，化石保管不当
properties.Degr_EN: The temple was destroyed during the Cultural Revolution, and the fossils were improperly kept.
properties.Repa_CN: 2021 年将化石（3945 件）移交龟山民俗博物馆。
properties.Repa_EN: In 2021, the fossils (3,945 pieces) were handed over to the Guishan Folk Museum.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑 - 革命纪念建筑
properties.Type_EN: Modern Historical Relics and Revolutionary Memorial Buildings
properties.Hist_CN: 江苏省最大的天主教堂之一，由法、德传教士设计。
properties.Hist_EN: One of the largest Catholic churches in Jiangsu Province, designed by French and German missionaries.
properties.Relae_CN: 徐州近代宗教建筑代表
properties.Relae_EN: A representative of modern religious buildings in Xuzhou.
properties.Relap_CN: 艾来沃（法国）、吴若瑟（德国）
properties.Degr_EN: The bell tower was damaged during the Cultural Revolution.
properties.Repa_CN: 1980 年修复钟楼；1992 年修缮大殿屋顶。
properties.Repa_EN: The bell tower was restored in 1980; the roof of the hall was repaired in 1992.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings in Modern Times
properties.Cons_CN: 清光绪三十三年 - 1907 年
properties.Cons_EN: 33rd Year of Guangxu in the Qing Dynasty - 1907
properties.Hist_CN: 中国国画大师出生、成长的院落。
properties.Hist_EN: The courtyard where the master of Chinese painting was born and raised.
properties.Relae_CN: 1985 年开放旧居；2007 年扩建新馆
properties.Relae_EN: The old residence was opened in 1985; a new building was expanded in 2007.
properties.Degr_EN: The original appearance was partially retained.
properties.Repa_CN: 1985 年按 “修旧如旧” 原则修复。
properties.Repa_EN: It was restored "as old as the old" in 1985.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 晋商贸易据点，供奉关公。
properties.Hist_EN: A trading stronghold of Jin merchants, dedicated to Emperor Guan.
properties.Relae_CN: 乾隆七年（1742 年）扩建；举办庙会联络乡邻
properties.Relae_EN: It was expanded in the 7th year of Qianlong (1742); temple fairs were held to connect villagers.
properties.Degr_EN: The statue of Emperor Guan was destroyed during the Cultural Revolution.
properties.Repa_CN: 1995 年重塑关公像；2006 年晋升省保。
properties.Repa_EN: The statue of Emperor Guan was reshaped in 1995; it was promoted to a provincial protection unit in 2006.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 徐州最早的青瓷窑址。
properties.Hist_EN: The earliest celadon kiln site in Xuzhou.
properties.Relae_CN: 烧制罐、壶等日用器皿，工艺体现技术进步
properties.Relae_EN: It fired daily utensils such as pots and jars, and its craftsmanship reflects technological progress.
properties.Degr_EN: Kiln fragments are exposed on the surface.
properties.Repa_EN: It has not been systematically excavated.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 仿故宫形制的南巡行宫。
properties.Hist_EN: A palace for the Southern Tour, shaped like the Forbidden City.
properties.Relae_CN: 乾隆四十九年乾隆帝在此驻留两晚；咸丰七年毁于战乱
properties.Relae_EN: Emperor Qianlong stayed here for two nights in the 49th year of Qianlong; it was destroyed in the war in the 7th year of Xianfeng.
properties.Degr_EN: Only rockery mounds and stones remain.
properties.Repa_EN: None

properties.Heri_EN: Site of Xuzhou Hanqiao Coal Mine
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Modern Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings
properties.Hist_CN: 江苏近代工业象征，有 130 年采矿历史。
properties.Hist_EN: A symbol of modern industry in Jiangsu Province, with a mining history of 130 years.
properties.Relae_CN: 1948 年国民党第三绥靖区部队起义；2014 年非法拆迁案
properties.Relae_EN: The uprising of the Third Appeasement District Troops of the Kuomintang in 1948; an illegal demolition case in 2014.
properties.Degr_CN: 2014 年 7 处文物（含 4 处省保建筑）被拆
properties.Degr_EN: 7 cultural relics (including 4 provincial protection buildings) were demolished in 2014.
properties.Repa_CN: 2015 年修复水塔等 11 栋建筑，建设工业遗产公园。
properties.Repa_EN: In 2015, 11 buildings such as water towers were repaired and an industrial heritage park was built.

properties.Heri_CN: 中国人民解放军华东野战军第三野战军前委司令部旧址
properties.Heri_EN: Former Site of the Former Committee Headquarters of the East China Field Army and the Third Field Army of the Chinese People's Liberation Army
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Modern Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings
properties.Hist_CN: 淮海战役指挥中心。
properties.Hist_EN: The command center of the Huaihai Campaign.
properties.Relae_CN: 在此制定徐蚌会战战略；第三野战军在此成立
properties.Relae_EN: The strategy of the Xubeng Battle was formulated here; the Third Field Army was established here.
properties.Repa_CN: 2006 年设纪念馆并对外开放。
properties.Repa_EN: A memorial hall was set up and opened to the public in 2006.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 彭城王家族墓。
properties.Hist_EN: The tomb of the Pengcheng Wang family.
properties.Relae_CN: 出土银缕玉衣、鎏金铜砚等
properties.Relae_EN: Silver jade clothes, gilded copper inkstones, etc. were unearthed.
properties.Repa_CN: 出土银缕玉衣、鎏金铜砚等
properties.Repa_EN: Silver jade clothes, gilded copper inkstones, etc. were unearthed.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Cons_EN: Northern Wei Dynasty to Tang and Song Dynasties
properties.Hist_CN: 佛教石刻艺术群。
properties.Hist_EN: A group of Buddhist stone carving artworks.
properties.Relae_CN: 包含释迦牟尼像等 42 个龛像
properties.Relae_EN: It includes 42 niche statues including Sakyamuni statues.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 90 年代安装防护栏。
properties.Repa_EN: Protective fences were installed in the 1990s.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 明清时期徐州最高行政机构。
properties.Hist_EN: The highest administrative agency in Xuzhou during the Ming and Qing dynasties.
properties.Relae_CN: 管辖徐淮地区军政事务
properties.Relae_EN: It had jurisdiction over military and political affairs in the Xuhuai area.
properties.Degr_EN: Only the lobby and side wings remain.
properties.Repa_EN: The lobby was restored in 2010.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 军事城堡遗址。
properties.Hist_EN: The ruins of a military castle.
properties.Relae_CN: 地方志记载为楚汉战争遗迹
properties.Relae_EN: Local chronicles record it as a relic of the Chu-Han War.
properties.Repa_EN: It has not been excavated.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 石拱桥，南北交通要道。
properties.Hist_EN: A stone arch bridge, a main north-south traffic road.
properties.Relae_EN: A hub for merchants and travelers.
properties.Degr_EN: The bridge body has partial cracks.
properties.Repa_EN: The bridge foundation was strengthened in 2008.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Modern Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings
properties.Hist_CN: “农业学大寨” 时期的水利工程。
properties.Hist_EN: A water conservancy project during the "Agricultural Dazhai" period.
properties.Relae_EN: It solved the irrigation problem in mountainous areas.
properties.Degr_EN: Some sections of the canal collapsed.
properties.Repa_EN: Partial maintenance was carried out in 2010.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 大汶口文化聚落遗址。
properties.Hist_EN: A settlement site of Dawenkou culture.
properties.Relae_CN: 出土房址、陶窑等生活遗迹
properties.Relae_EN: Living relics such as house sites and pottery kilns were unearthed.
properties.Repa_EN: A trial archaeological excavation was carried out in 2009.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 百年老字号酱园，传统酿造工艺代表。
properties.Hist_EN: A century-old time-honored sauce garden, a representative of traditional brewing technology.
properties.Relae_CN: 供应官盐及民用酱品；民国时期为徐州四大酱园之一
properties.Relae_EN: It supplied official salt and civilian sauces; during the Republic of China, it was one of the four major sauce gardens in Xuzhou.
properties.Degr_CN: 建筑局部腐朽，酱缸等工具散落
properties.Degr_EN: The building was partially decayed, and tools such as sauce jars were scattered.
properties.Repa_CN: 2008 年修复门楼；2019 年设非物质文化遗产展厅。
properties.Repa_EN: The gatehouse was restored in 2008; an intangible cultural heritage exhibition hall was set up in 2019.

properties.Heri_EN: Martyrs' Tomb of Martyr Wang Jie
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑 - 革命纪念建筑
properties.Type_EN: Modern and Modern Historical Relics and Revolutionary Memorial Buildings
properties.Hist_CN: 纪念 “一不怕苦、二不怕死” 的英雄战士。
properties.Hist_EN: Commemorating the heroic soldier who "feared neither hardship nor death".
properties.Relae_EN: Wang Jie sacrificed himself to protect the militia.
properties.Repa_CN: 2015 年扩建纪念馆；列为省级爱国主义教育基地。
properties.Repa_EN: The memorial hall was expanded in 2015; it was listed as a provincial patriotic education base.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Cons_EN: 7th Year of Kangxi in the Qing Dynasty (1668)
properties.Hist_CN: 苏轼、米芾等文人登山题刻，记录宋代徐州文化盛况；包含 “放鹤”“招鹤” 二亭遗址。
properties.Hist_EN: Inscriptions by literati such as Su Shi and Mi Fu when they climbed the mountain, recording the cultural prosperity of Xuzhou in the Song Dynasty; including the sites of the two pavilions of "Fanghe" and "Zhaohe".
properties.Relae_EN: None
properties.Degr_EN: Some stone carvings have weathered and eroded.
properties.Repa_CN: 20 世纪 90 年代加装防护玻璃罩。
properties.Repa_EN: Protective glass covers were added in the 1990s.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 供奉关羽的祖庙，明清商人祭祀中心。
properties.Hist_EN: An ancestral temple dedicated to Guan Yu, a sacrifice center for merchants in the Ming and Qing dynasties.
properties.Relae_CN: 农历五月十三日 “关帝磨刀日” 庙会
properties.Relae_EN: A temple fair is held on the 13th day of the fifth lunar month, known as "Guan Di Sharpening Day".
properties.Degr_CN: 文革时期像被毁，建筑改作工厂
properties.Degr_EN: The statue was destroyed during the Cultural Revolution, and the building was converted into a factory.
properties.Repa_CN: 2002 年重建大殿；2010 年重塑关帝像。
properties.Repa_EN: The main hall was rebuilt in 2002; the statue of Guan Di was reshaped in 2010.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 两座封土墓，疑似彭城王家族墓。
properties.Hist_EN: Two mounded tombs, suspected to be the tomb of the Pengcheng Wang family.
properties.Relae_CN: 出土陶楼、铜缕玉衣残片等
properties.Relae_EN: Pottery towers and fragments of copper threads and jade clothes were unearthed.
properties.Degr_CN: 封土被农田侵占，墓葬未发掘
properties.Degr_EN: The sealed soil was encroached upon by farmland, and the tomb has not been excavated.
properties.Repa_CN: 1987 年立保护碑；2013 年考古勘探确认范围。
properties.Repa_EN: A protection monument was erected in 1987; the scope was confirmed through archaeological exploration in 2013.

properties.Heri_EN: Dacheng Hall of Fengxian Confucian Temple
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 苏北保存最完整的明代文庙建筑。
properties.Hist_EN: The most complete Ming Dynasty Confucian Temple building in northern Jiangsu.
properties.Relae_CN: 清代增建崇圣祠；民国时期改作学校
properties.Relae_EN: The Chongsheng Shrine was added in the Qing Dynasty; it was converted into a school in the Republic of China.
properties.Degr_EN: The bucket arches were deformed, and the color paintings faded.
properties.Repa_CN: 1983 年修复大成殿；2020 年修缮屋顶。
properties.Repa_EN: The Dacheng Hall was repaired in 1983; the roof was repaired in 2020.

properties.Heri_EN: Dafeng Song Monument of Pei County
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Cons_EN: 10th Year of Dade in the Yuan Dynasty (1306)
properties.Hist_CN: 刻有刘邦《大风歌》的石碑，现存三块（汉碑残片、元碑完整、清碑仿刻）。
properties.Hist_EN: A stone carved with Liu Bang's "Song of the Great Wind", with three existing pieces (a remnant of the Han stele, a complete Yuan stele, and an imitated Qing stele).
properties.Relae_CN: 汉碑残片藏沛县博物馆；元碑是唯一完整的汉代诗文刻石
properties.Relae_EN: The remnant of the Han stele is in the Pei County Museum; the Yuan stele is the only complete stone with inscriptions of Han Dynasty poems and texts.
properties.Degr_CN: 汉碑仅存 1/4，元碑局部风化
properties.Degr_EN: Only 1/4 of the Han stele remains, and the Yuan stele is partially weathered.
properties.Repa_CN: 1992 年建碑亭保护；2013 年进行数字拓印。
properties.Repa_EN: A stele pavilion was built for protection in 1992; digital rubbing was carried out in 2013.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 明末清初 “徐州二遗民” 之一的抗清诗人墓。
properties.Hist_EN: One of the anti-Qing poets known as "Two Remnants of Xuzhou" in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties.
properties.Relae_CN: 墓碑刻有自题诗 “故里江山全易主，何处渔樵问余生”
properties.Relae_EN: The tombstone is engraved with his self-written poem "The rivers and mountains of the homeland are all overgrown, where to ask the fishermen and woodcutters for the rest of my life".
properties.Degr_CN: 文革时期墓碑被砸，封土夷平
properties.Degr_EN: The tombstone was smashed during the Cultural Revolution, and the soil was flattened.
properties.Repa_CN: 1987 年重立墓碑；2001 年迁葬铜山吕梁山。
properties.Repa_EN: The tombstone was re-erected in 1987; he was reburied in Luliang Mountain, Tongshan in 2001.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings in Modern and Modern Times
properties.Hist_CN: 教会学校的主体建筑，采用中西合璧的风格。
properties.Hist_EN: The main building of a church school, combining Chinese and Western styles.
properties.Relae_CN: 是徐州近代教育的发源地，培养出了首批新式学生。
properties.Relae_EN: The birthplace of modern education in Xuzhou; it trained the first batch of new-style students.
properties.Degr_CN: 木楼梯腐朽，外墙出现裂缝
properties.Degr_EN: The wooden stairs decayed, and there were cracks on the exterior walls
properties.Repa_CN: 2015 年对建筑结构进行加固；2022 年复原彩色玻璃窗。
properties.Repa_EN: The structure was strengthened in 2015; the stained glass windows were restored in 2022.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Cons_EN: Neolithic to Spring and Autumn Period
properties.Hist_CN: 吴越争霸的前沿阵地，伍子胥在此修建 “越来溪” 防线。
properties.Hist_EN: A frontier of the hegemony between Wu and Yue, Wu Zixu built the "Yuelai Creek" defense line here.
properties.Relae_CN: 出土几何印纹陶；与吴王阖闾 “射南城” 传说相关
properties.Relae_EN: Geometric imprinted pottery was unearthed; it is related to the legend of "Shooting South City" by King Helu of Wu.
properties.Degr_CN: 现代建筑占据核心区域
properties.Degr_EN: Modern buildings occupy the core area
properties.Repa_CN: 1956 年进行试掘；2013 年立保护界碑。
properties.Repa_EN: A trial excavation was carried out in 1956; a protective boundary monument was erected in 2013.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: “江南第一才子” 唐寅的安葬之地，原属桃花庵，有祝允明所书碑刻；清代唐仲冕重建。
properties.Hist_EN: The burial place of "the First Talent in Jiangnan" Tang Yin, originally part of Taohua Monastery with an inscription by Zhu Yunming; it was rebuilt by Tang Zhongmian in the Qing Dynasty.
properties.Relae_EN: None
properties.Degr_EN: The stele pavilion was smashed during the Cultural Revolution
properties.Repa_CN: 1985 年重建碑亭；2008 年扩建纪念馆。
properties.Repa_EN: The stele pavilion was rebuilt in 1985; the memorial hall was expanded in 2008.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 颜佩韦等五位反阉义士的合葬墓。
properties.Hist_EN: A joint burial place for anti-eunuch martyrs and righteous men such as Yan Peiwei.
properties.Relae_CN: 张溥撰写《五人墓碑记》；与复社反阉运动相关
properties.Relae_EN: Zhang Pu wrote Five Tombstones; it is related to the anti-eunuch movement of the Restoration Society.
properties.Degr_EN: The handwriting on the tombstone is blurred
properties.Repa_CN: 1956 年整修墓葬；2019 年重刻碑文。
properties.Repa_EN: The tomb was renovated in 1956; the inscription was re-engraved in 2019.

properties.Heri_EN: I-character Hall of City God Temple
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 江南地区规模最大的城隍庙主殿，呈 “工” 字形布局。
properties.Hist_EN: The main hall of the largest City God Temple in Jiangnan, with an I-shaped layout.
properties.Relae_CN: 巡抚周忱增建；清代增设十三府城隍
properties.Relae_EN: Governor Zhou Chen added to it; the city gods of the thirteen prefectures were added in the Qing Dynasty.
properties.Degr_EN: The apse was damaged by fire
properties.Repa_CN: 2004 年重建后殿；2013 年修复月台。
properties.Repa_EN: The apse was rebuilt in 2004; the platform was restored in 2013.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 花石纲遗石，为江南地区最优质的太湖石。
properties.Hist_EN: A relic stone of Huashigang, the best Taihu stone in Jiangnan.
properties.Relae_CN: 朱勔采运未竟；乾隆帝将其移入织造府行宫
properties.Relae_EN: Zhu Mian's mining and transportation were not completed; Emperor Qianlong moved it into the Weaving Department Palace.
properties.Repa_CN: 1963 年加固基座；2021 年清理石孔。
properties.Repa_EN: The base was strengthened in 1963; the stone holes were cleaned in 2021.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 隆平府纪功碑，碑上浮雕颂扬张士诚政绩。
properties.Hist_EN: A memorial monument of Longping Mansion, with reliefs praising Zhang Shicheng's political achievements.
properties.Relae_CN: 元代唯一颂扬农民军的石碑；清代移入北寺塔
properties.Relae_EN: The only monument praising the peasant army at the end of the Yuan Dynasty; it was moved into the North Temple Pagoda in the Qing Dynasty.
properties.Degr_EN: The stele was smashed during the Cultural Revolution
properties.Repa_CN: 1982 年修复石碑；2000 年增设防护盾。
properties.Repa_EN: The stele was restored in 1982; a protective shield was added in 2000.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 抗倭堡垒，是苏州现存唯一与 “枫桥夜泊” 相关的关楼。
properties.Hist_EN: An anti-Japanese fortress, the only preserved Guanlou (pass building) in Suzhou associated with the "Fengqiao Night Mooring" scene.
properties.Relae_CN: 1860 年太平军攻破此关；关楼木构遭虫蛀
properties.Relae_EN: In 1860, the Taiping Army broke through the pass; the wooden structure of the Guanlou was damaged by moths.
properties.Degr_EN: The wooden structure of the Guanlou was damaged by moths
properties.Repa_CN: 1987 年修复垛口；2014 年更换楼板。
properties.Repa_EN: The crenels were repaired in 1987; the floor slabs were replaced in 2014.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 因张继《枫桥夜泊》一诗闻名。
properties.Hist_EN: Famous for Zhang Ji's poem "Fengqiao Night Mooring".
properties.Relae_CN: 俞樾书写诗碑；遭日军破坏后重建
properties.Relae_EN: Yu Yue wrote the poetry stele; it was rebuilt after being destroyed by the Japanese army.
properties.Degr_CN: 晚清时期大殿毁于火灾
properties.Degr_EN: The hall was destroyed by fire in the late Qing Dynasty
properties.Repa_CN: 1906 年重建大雄宝殿；2008 年铸造 108 吨仿唐钟。
properties.Repa_EN: The Daxiong Baodian (Main Hall) was rebuilt in 1906; a 108-ton Tang-style imitation bell was cast in 2008.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 顾文彬所建，集宋元园林风格于一体的园林。
properties.Hist_EN: Built by Gu Wenbin, a garden integrating the styles of the Song and Yuan dynasties.
properties.Relae_CN: 采用过云楼藏画设计蓝图；梅兰芳常在 “戏厅” 演出
properties.Relae_EN: It adopted the design blueprint of the paintings collected in Guoyun Building; Mei Lanfang often performed in the "Theater Hall".
properties.Degr_EN: The paintings on the corridor peeled off
properties.Repa_CN: 1953 年重建回廊；2017 年修复 “博雅琴亭”。
properties.Repa_EN: The corridor was rebuilt in 1953; the "Po Xianqin Pavilion" was restored in 2017.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 律宗道场，有 400 年历史的 “浴龟池”。
properties.Hist_EN: A dojo of Luzong (a branch of Buddhism), with a "Yuanyuan" (a pond for releasing turtles) that has a history of 400 years.
properties.Relae_CN: 明代徐泰时舍宅建寺；虚云大师受戒之地
properties.Relae_EN: Xu Taishishe of the Ming Dynasty built the temple; it was the ordination place of Master Xuyun.
properties.Degr_EN: Some gold leaf fell off in the Arhat Hall
properties.Repa_CN: 1980 年重塑罗汉像；2019 年修复佛坛。
properties.Repa_EN: The Arhats were reshaped in 1980; the altar was restored in 2019.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 大运河现存唯一的古驿站，是胥江水马枢纽。
properties.Hist_EN: The only surviving ancient post station of the Grand Canal, a hub of Xujiang Water Transport.
properties.Relae_EN: Its appearance is depicted in The Prosperity of Gusu.
properties.Repa_CN: 1989 年修复亭碑；2012 年加固石台。
properties.Repa_EN: The pavilion monument was restored in 1989; the stone platform was strengthened in 2012.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 万历年间 “状元宰相” 申时行的丧葬神道。
properties.Hist_EN: The funeral shrine of the "Zhuangyuan Prime Minister" (a prime minister who was once the top scholar in the imperial examination) of the Wanli period.
properties.Relae_CN: 留存马文升所书碑刻；清初遭农民军破坏
properties.Relae_EN: Ma Wenchen's works are preserved here; it was destroyed by the peasant army in the early Qing Dynasty.
properties.Degr_CN: 地宫被盗；文革时期石象生被砸
properties.Degr_EN: The underground palace was stolen; the stone statues were smashed during the Cultural Revolution
properties.Repa_CN: 2001 年收集碎片；2015 年建设遗址公园。
properties.Repa_EN: The fragments were collected in 2001; a site park was built in 2015.

properties.Heri_CN: 范文正公忠烈庙及天平山庄
properties.Heri_EN: Fan Wenzheng Gong Loyal Martyr Temple and Tianping Villa
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 范仲淹祖祠与范允临所建山庄。
properties.Hist_EN: The ancestral hall of Fan Zhongyan and the villa built by Fan Yun.
properties.Relae_CN: “先天下之忧而忧” 的精神象征；白居易题 “白云泉”
properties.Relae_EN: A spiritual symbol of "being the first to worry about the world's troubles and the last to enjoy its pleasures"; Bai Juyi inscribed "Baiyun Spring" here.
properties.Degr_EN: Some buildings of the villa collapsed
properties.Repa_CN: 1989 年修复忠烈庙；2005 年重建来燕榭。
properties.Repa_EN: The Loyal Martyr Temple was restored in 1989; the "Laiyanxie" (a building) was rebuilt in 2005.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: “天下第一文章” 宰相王鏊的祖祠。
properties.Hist_EN: The ancestral hall of the "No.1 Article in the World" Prime Minister Wang Ao.
properties.Relae_CN: 原为景德寺；唐寅题 “天下第一文章”
properties.Relae_EN: Originally Jingde Temple; Tang Yin inscribed "No.1 Article in the World" here.
properties.Degr_EN: The beams and columns of the main hall tilted
properties.Repa_CN: 1980 年修缮；2018 年更换腐朽斗拱。
properties.Repa_EN: It was repaired in 1980; the rotten bucket arches were replaced in 2018.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 有 “江南桥王” 之称，为薄墩联拱桥。
properties.Hist_EN: Known as the "King of Bridges in Jiangnan", a thin and solid multi-arch bridge.
properties.Relae_CN: 净修和尚募资修建以便利交通；1957 年拓宽桥面
properties.Relae_EN: Monk Jingxiu raised funds to build it for convenience; the bridge deck was widened in 1957.
properties.Repa_CN: 1985 年恢复原貌；2002 年加固拱券。
properties.Repa_EN: It was restored to its original appearance in 1985; the arch supports were strengthened in 2002.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 文徵明侄子文伯仁所建，园内有五座命名太湖石峰。
properties.Hist_EN: Built by Wen Boren, the nephew of Wen Zhengming, with five Taihu stone peaks named after different themes.
properties.Relae_CN: 张岱《陶庵梦忆》记载园景；民国时期散为民居
properties.Relae_EN: Zhang Dai's Tao'an Dream Memories records the garden scenery; it was scattered as residential areas in the Republic of China.
properties.Repa_EN: The Rokkaku Pavilion was rebuilt in 2011.

properties.Heri_CN: 苏州美术专科学校旧址
properties.Heri_EN: Former Site of Suzhou Academy of Fine Arts
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings in Modern and Contemporary Times
properties.Hist_CN: 颜文樑创办，是中国首个设有西画系的美术院校。
properties.Hist_EN: Founded by Yan Wenliang, China's first academy with a Western Painting Department.
properties.Relae_CN: 仿巴黎美术学院希腊柱廊；培养出李可染等人才
properties.Relae_EN: It imitated the Greek colonnade of the Paris Academy of Fine Arts; it cultivated talents such as Li Keran.
properties.Repa_CN: 2012 年修复罗马柱；2020 年更名为颜文樑纪念馆。
properties.Repa_EN: The Roman columns were restored in 2012; it was renamed Yan Wenliang Memorial Hall in 2020.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 传说伍子胥悬首之地，现存城墙长 600 米。
properties.Hist_EN: Legend has it that Wu Zixu's head was hung here; the existing city wall is 600 meters long.
properties.Relae_CN: “古胥永翠” 景点组成部分；1938 年日军炸毁城楼
properties.Relae_EN: It is part of the "Guxu Yongcui" scenic spot; the city tower was blown up by the Japanese army in 1938.
properties.Repa_CN: 2004 年重建城楼；2019 年修复水门。
properties.Repa_EN: The city tower was rebuilt in 2004; the water gate was repaired in 2019.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 文徵明旧居，呈 “工” 字形厅堂布局。
properties.Hist_EN: The former residence of Wen Zhengming, with an I-shaped hall.
properties.Relae_CN: 文震孟出生地；《长物志》撰写处
properties.Relae_EN: The birthplace of Wen Zhenmeng; the office where Changwuzhi was written.
properties.Degr_EN: The back hall was occupied and additional buildings were built
properties.Repa_CN: 2001 年收回修复；2015 年修复 “听云阁”。
properties.Repa_EN: The back hall was reclaimed and restored in 2001; the "Tingyun Pavilion" was restored in 2015.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 归氏园林，清代李鸿章曾借作安徽会馆。
properties.Hist_EN: The garden of the Gui family; Li Hongzhang borrowed it as the Anhui Guild Hall in the Qing Dynasty.
properties.Relae_CN: “小林屋” 水假山为叠山杰作；太平天国时期遭毁后归园主归湛初
properties.Relae_EN: The "Xiaolin House" water rockery is a masterpiece of rock stacking; it was destroyed during the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and later returned to the Gui family (the owner of the garden).
properties.Relap_EN: The Gui family (owner of the garden)
properties.Degr_EN: The water rockery cave was blocked
properties.Repa_CN: 1953 年疏通山洞；2017 年安装循环水系统。
properties.Repa_EN: The cave was cleared in 1953; a circulating water system was installed in 2017.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 体仁阁大学士吴坛的府邸。
properties.Hist_EN: The mansion of Wu Tan, a Grand Scholar of the Tiren Pavilion.
properties.Relae_CN: 有 “四时读书乐” 砖雕门楼；留存乾隆御赐匾额
properties.Relae_EN: It has a brick-carved gatehouse with the theme of "Four Seasons of Reading Pleasure"; a Qianlong imperial plaque is preserved here.
properties.Repa_CN: 2005 年修复正厅；2020 年清理砖雕。
properties.Repa_EN: The main hall was restored in 2005; the brick carvings were cleaned in 2020.

properties.Heri_EN: Former Site of Jiangsu Governor's Yamen
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 江南地区最高行政机构。
properties.Hist_EN: The highest administrative body in Jiangnan.
properties.Relae_CN: 旷中为首任巡抚；林则徐任巡抚时在此禁烟；1860 年改为忠王府
properties.Relae_EN: Kuang Zhong was the first governor; Lin Zexu served as governor here to ban opium; it was converted into the Zhongwang Mansion in 1860.
properties.Degr_EN: Only the gate and the ceremonial gate remain
properties.Repa_CN: 1982 年立碑；2010 年考古发现明代地砖。
properties.Repa_EN: A monument was erected in 1982; Ming Dynasty floor tiles were discovered through archaeology in 2010.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 省级司法机构，毗邻巡抚衙门。
properties.Hist_EN: A provincial judicial institution, adjacent to the Governor's Office.
properties.Relae_CN: 与晚清法部改革相关；1912 年程德全在此宣布江苏独立
properties.Relae_EN: It was related to the late Qing Dynasty legal reform; Cheng Dequan declared Jiangsu's independence here in 1912.
properties.Degr_EN: The main building no longer exists

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 状元宰相府邸，留存 “留余堂” 匾额。
properties.Hist_EN: The mansion of the "Zhuangyuan Prime Minister" (Pan Shien), with the "Liuyu Hall" plaque.
properties.Relae_CN: 包含潘祖荫藏书楼；太平天国时期曾作为英王府
properties.Relae_EN: It includes Pan Zuyin's library; it was used as the British Palace during the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.
properties.Repa_CN: 2003 年修复纱帽厅；2018 年重建藏书楼。
properties.Repa_EN: The "Shahatang" (a hall) was restored in 2003; the library was rebuilt in 2018.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 金石学家吴云的私家园林，因园内枫树而得名。
properties.Hist_EN: A private garden of Wu Yun, a Jinshi (a successful candidate in the imperial examination), named after the maple trees here.
properties.Relae_CN: 曾是苏州知府吴云的 “两罍轩” 书斋；俞樾、吴昌硕常在此雅集
properties.Relae_EN: It was once the study "Liangjixuan" of the Suzhou Prefect Wu Yun; Yu Yue and Wu Changshuo often held literary gatherings here.
properties.Degr_CN: 假山局部坍塌，建筑遭虫蛀
properties.Degr_EN: The rockery partially collapsed, and the building was damaged by moths
properties.Repa_CN: 1983 年修复听枫仙馆；2015 年重建墨香阁。
properties.Repa_EN: The "Tingfengxian Pavilion" was restored in 1983; the "Moxiang Pavilion" was rebuilt in 2015.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 苏州最高的单孔石拱桥，是大运河遗产点。
properties.Hist_EN: The tallest single-hole stone arch bridge in Suzhou, a heritage site of the Grand Canal.
properties.Relae_CN: 南宋时期重建；1863 年被太平军炸毁后清代重修
properties.Relae_EN: It was reconstructed in the Southern Song Dynasty; it was blown up by the Taiping Army in 1863 and rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty.
properties.Degr_CN: 桥栏风化，拱券出现裂缝
properties.Degr_EN: The bridge railings have weathered, and the arch has cracks
properties.Repa_CN: 1963 年加固桥基；2020 年进行修复工程。
properties.Repa_EN: The bridge foundation was strengthened in 1963; restoration work was carried out in 2020.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 大学士吴一鹏的故居，是山塘街最大的宅院。
properties.Hist_EN: The former residence of Wu Yipeng, the largest mansion on Shantang Street.
properties.Relae_CN: 乾隆下江南时曾在此驻跸；太平天国时期改为王府
properties.Relae_EN: Emperor Qianlong once stayed here during his southern tours; it was converted into a palace during the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.
properties.Repa_CN: 2003 年修复主厅；2018 年复原轿厅。
properties.Repa_EN: The main hall was restored in 2003; the sedan hall was restored in 2018.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 小型宅园的代表，以水池为中心布局。
properties.Hist_EN: A representative of small mansions, with a pool as the central layout.
properties.Relae_CN: 被收录于《苏州古典园林》；20 世纪 80 年代贝聿铭曾前来考察
properties.Relae_EN: It is included in Suzhou Classical Gardens; Pei Leoh Ming inspected it in the 1980s.
properties.Repa_CN: 2010 年落架大修；2021 年重绘游廊。
properties.Repa_EN: It was overhauled in 2010; the veranda was repainted in 2021.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 九孔连拱桥，是 “石湖串月” 奇观的观赏地。
properties.Hist_EN: A nine-hole arch bridge, the location of the "Stone Lake String Moon" wonder.
properties.Relae_CN: 范成大隐居石湖时经常游览此处；桥墩留存南宋水兽雕刻
properties.Relae_EN: Fan Chengda often visited and lived in seclusion in Stone Lake; the bridge piers preserve the Southern Song Dynasty water beast sculptures.
properties.Repa_CN: 1957 年重建；2008 年恢复水兽雕刻。
properties.Repa_EN: It was rebuilt in 1957; the water beast carvings were restored in 2008.

properties.Heri_EN: Tiger Hill Sword Pool and Cliff Rock Carvings
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 传为吴王阖闾的葬地，包含颜真卿所书 “虎丘剑池” 字迹。
properties.Hist_EN: The supposed burial site of King Helu of Wu in the Spring and Autumn Period, including Yan Zhenqing's calligraphy of "Tiger Hill Sword Pool".
properties.Relae_CN: 有王羲之 “剑池” 题字；1955 年曾抽干池水寻找墓门
properties.Relae_EN: Wang Xizhi's "Sword Pool" inscription; the pond water was drained to find the tomb door in 1955.
properties.Degr_EN: The cliff wall leaks water, and the stone carvings have weathered
properties.Repa_CN: 2009 年加固崖体；2018 年安装排水系统。
properties.Repa_EN: The cliff body was strengthened in 2009; a drainage system was installed in 2018.

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings in Modern Times
properties.Hist_CN: 国学大师晚年居所，“章氏国学讲习会” 旧址
properties.Hist_EN: The residence of the master of Chinese studies in his later years, the site of the "Zhang's Seminar on Chinese Studies"
properties.Relae_CN: 鲁迅多次到访；讲习会培养钱玄同等学者
properties.Relae_EN: Lu Xun visited many times; the seminar trained Qian Xuantong
properties.Degr_EN: The wooden floor of the study was rotten
properties.Repa_CN: 1986 年设纪念馆；2015 年复原讲习会旧址
properties.Repa_EN: A memorial hall was set up in 1986; the seminar site was restored in 2015

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 徽商吴氏所建，留存 “尚志堂” 楠木厅
properties.Hist_EN: Built by Huishang Wu family, preserving the "Shangzhitang" Nanmu Hall
properties.Relae_CN: 太平天国时期为纳王府；1927 年为中共苏州独立支部驻地
properties.Relae_EN: Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Nawang Mansion; in 1927, it was the station of the Suzhou Independent Branch of the Communist Party of China
properties.Repa_CN: 2001 年修复楠木厅；2018 年举办革命历史展览
properties.Repa_EN: The Nanmu Hall was restored in 2001; an exhibition on revolutionary history was held in 2018

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 由道观改建为住宅，沈秉成购得后作为别墅
properties.Hist_EN: Renovated from a Taoist temple, purchased by Shen Bingcheng as a villa
properties.Relae_CN: 沈秉成与严永华在此撰写《鲽砚庐诗钞》
properties.Relae_EN: Shen Bingcheng and Yan Yonghua wrote "Dieyanlu Shichao" here
properties.Degr_EN: Termite erosion in the back building
properties.Repa_CN: 1995 年进行灭蚁处理；2020 年加固梁架
properties.Repa_EN: Ant control treatment was carried out in 1995; the beam frame was reinforced in 2020

properties.Heri_EN: Former Site of Suzhou Customs Tax Department
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings in Modern Times
properties.Hist_CN: 近现代海关建筑群，融合中西风格
properties.Hist_EN: Modern customs complex with a combination of Chinese and Western styles
properties.Relae_CN: 征收粮食关税；1949 年由中国人民解放军接管
properties.Relae_EN: Collected grain tariffs; taken over by the Chinese People's Liberation Army in 1949
properties.Degr_EN: The clock tower mechanism was damaged
properties.Repa_CN: 2013 年修复主体建筑；2019 年复原税务展厅
properties.Repa_EN: The main building was restored in 2013; the tax exhibition hall was restored in 2019

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings in Modern Times
properties.Hist_CN: 银行家别墅群，新式石库门里弄
properties.Hist_EN: Banker's villa group, new Shikumen lane
properties.Relae_CN: 上海商人避战迁居至此；为《围城》取景地
properties.Relae_EN: Shanghai merchants moved here to avoid the war; filming location of "Fortress Besieged"
properties.Degr_EN: The exterior wall cement fell off
properties.Repa_CN: 2016 年复原门楣雕刻；2022 年进行结构加固
properties.Repa_EN: The lintel carvings were restored in 2016; the structure was reinforced in 2022

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 东山明代厅堂，楠木金柱承重
properties.Hist_EN: Ming Dynasty hall in Dongshan, with Nanmu golden pillars bearing the load
properties.Relae_CN: 洞庭商帮议事厅；清代改为粮仓
properties.Relae_EN: Council hall of the Dongting Merchant Gang; converted into a granary in the Qing Dynasty
properties.Degr_EN: The beam frame tilted more than 10°
properties.Repa_CN: 2005 年进行纠偏加固；2017 年更换腐朽金柱
properties.Repa_EN: Deviation correction and reinforcement were carried out in 2005; the decayed golden pillars were replaced in 2017

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 三孔石拱桥，苏州现存最长的明代桥梁
properties.Hist_EN: Three-hole stone arch bridge, the longest Ming Dynasty bridge in Suzhou
properties.Relae_CN: 连接山塘街与普济堂；桥栏刻有捐建者姓名
properties.Relae_EN: Connects Shantang Street and Puji Hall; the names of donors are engraved on the bridge railings
properties.Degr_EN: The arch of the middle hole cracked
properties.Repa_CN: 1982 年加固桥墩；2014 年修复栏杆
properties.Repa_EN: The piers were reinforced in 1982; the railings were repaired in 2014

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 范仲淹创办，中国最早的慈善机构之一
properties.Hist_EN: Founded by Fan Zhongyan, one of China's earliest charity organizations
properties.Relae_CN: 资助范氏族人；明清时期扩建至千亩
properties.Relae_EN: Supported the Fan clan; expanded to 1,000 mu in the Ming and Qing dynasties
properties.Degr_EN: Only the Xiangtang and stone steles remain
properties.Repa_CN: 1956 年立保护碑；2021 年建设义庄文化中心
properties.Repa_EN: A protection stele was erected in 1956; the Yizhuang Cultural Center was built in 2021

properties.Heri_CN: 景海女子师范学校旧址
properties.Heri_EN: Former Site of Jinghai Women's Normal School
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Type_CN: 近现代重要史迹及代表性建筑
properties.Type_EN: Important Historical Sites and Representative Buildings in Modern Times
properties.Hist_CN: 美国监理会创办的女子学校，培养早期女教师
properties.Hist_EN: A women's school run by the American Supervisorate, training early female teachers
properties.Relae_CN: 宋氏三姐妹曾在此就读；1951 年改为苏州幼儿师范学校
properties.Relae_EN: The three Song sisters studied here; renamed Suzhou Normal School for Preschool Education in 1951
properties.Degr_EN: The colored windows of the chapel were broken
properties.Repa_CN: 2000 年修复钟楼；2018 年复原教室
properties.Repa_EN: The clock tower was restored in 2000; the classrooms were restored in 2018

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: “中兴四将” 之一韩世忠的墓碑，有宋高宗赵构手书铭文
properties.Hist_EN: Tomb of one of the "Four Generals of Zhongxing", with inscriptions handwritten by Emperor Gaozong Zhao Gou of the Song Dynasty
properties.Relae_CN: 铭文 1.3 万字记述抗金功绩；文革时期石碑被砸
properties.Relae_EN: The 13,000-character inscription describes anti-Jin merits; the stele was smashed during the Cultural Revolution
properties.Degr_EN: The stele was broken and the base was lost
properties.Repa_CN: 1982 年拼接碎裂石碑；2010 年重建碑亭
properties.Repa_EN: The fragmented stele was assembled in 1982; the stele pavilion was rebuilt in 2010

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 嘉兴经厂刻制的《楞严经》石板
properties.Hist_EN: Stone slabs engraved with the "Lankavatara Sutra" by Jiaxing Sutra Workshop
properties.Relae_CN: 抗战时期部分被日军掠走；1958 年发现埋藏的残石
properties.Relae_EN: Part of it was plundered by the Japanese army during the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression; buried fragmented stones were discovered in 1958
properties.Degr_EN: The fragmented stones were severely weathered
properties.Repa_CN: 2001 年保存拓片；2015 年加装玻璃罩
properties.Repa_EN: Rubbings were preserved in 2001; a glass cover was added in 2015

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: “香山帮” 鼻祖、天安门设计者蒯祥的墓葬
properties.Hist_EN: Founder of the "Xiangshan Gang" and designer of Tiananmen
properties.Relae_CN: 墓前立 “奉天诰命” 碑；享堂留存 “匠圣” 匾额
properties.Relae_EN: A "Fengtian Gaoming" stele stands in front of the tomb; the Xiangtang preserves the "Craftsman Sage" plaque
properties.Degr_EN: The Xiangtang was destroyed during the Cultural Revolution
properties.Repa_CN: 1982 年重立墓碑；2005 年建设纪念园
properties.Repa_EN: A new tombstone was erected in 1982; a memorial garden was built in 2005

properties.Heri_EN: Nanmu Hall and Stone Carving Artworks
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 东山明代官宅，金丝楠木梁柱
properties.Hist_EN: Ming Dynasty official residence in Dongshan, with golden silk nanmu beams and columns
properties.Relae_CN: 太平天国时期前堂被毁；留存 “鲤鱼跃龙门” 石刻
properties.Relae_EN: The front hall was destroyed by the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom; the "Carp Leaping Over the Dragon Gate" stone carving remains
properties.Repa_CN: 1998 年修复楠木结构；2019 年清理石刻
properties.Repa_EN: The nanmu structure was restored in 1998; the stone carvings were cleaned in 2019

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 官民合建的公益井亭
properties.Hist_EN: Public welfare well pavilion co-built by the government and the people
properties.Relae_CN: 井栏刻 34 位捐建者姓名；清代增建石亭
properties.Relae_EN: The names of 34 donors are engraved on the well railing; a stone pavilion was added in the Qing Dynasty
properties.Degr_EN: Settlement of the base of the stone pavilion pillars
properties.Repa_CN: 1987 年加固井台；2013 年修复斗拱
properties.Repa_EN: The well platform was reinforced in 1987; the bucket arches were restored in 2013

properties.Heri_CN: 三山岛遗址及哺乳动物化石地点
properties.Heri_EN: Sanshan Island Site and Mammalian Fossil Location
properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 太湖地区最早的人类活动遗迹
properties.Hist_EN: The earliest remains of human activities in Taihu Lake
properties.Relae_CN: 1985 年发现石器和骨器；伴生最后鬣狗化石
properties.Relae_EN: Stone tools and bone tools were discovered in 1985; associated with the fossils of the last hyena
properties.Degr_EN: Some sites were eroded by lake water
properties.Repa_CN: 2006 年建设遗址博物馆；2021 年加固湖岸
properties.Repa_EN: A site museum was built in 2006; the lakeshore was reinforced in 2021

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 武康石单孔拱桥，桥心有莲瓣浮雕
properties.Hist_EN: Wukang stone single-hole arch bridge with lotus petal reliefs at the bridge center
properties.Relae_CN: 原为寺前桥梁；明代王鏊题 “大觉” 二字
properties.Relae_EN: Originally a bridge in front of the temple; inscribed "Dajue" by Wang Ao in the Ming Dynasty
properties.Repa_CN: 1990 年重刻栏杆；2017 年复原莲瓣雕刻
properties.Repa_EN: The railings were re-engraved in 1990; the lotus carvings were restored in 2017

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 舍利方塔，顾野王舍宅为寺所建
properties.Hist_EN: Sarira square pagoda, built by Gu Yewang donating his residence as a temple
properties.Relae_CN: 南宋改为通观音寺；清代康熙赐 “慈云普护” 匾额
properties.Relae_EN: Renamed Tongguan Yin Temple in the Southern Song Dynasty; Emperor Kangxi of the Qing Dynasty granted the plaque "Ciyun Puhu"
properties.Repa_CN: 1986 年全面大修；2014 年更换避雷针
properties.Repa_EN: A full-scale overhaul was carried out in 1986; the lightning rod was replaced in 2014

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 道教 “第九洞天”，包含唐、宋、明、清题刻
properties.Hist_EN: Taoist "Ninth Cave Heaven", including inscriptions from the Tang, Song, Ming and Qing dynasties
properties.Relae_CN: 白居易书 “林屋洞”；李根源刻 “无碍”
properties.Relae_EN: Bai Juyi wrote "Linwu Cave"; Li Gengen engraved "Wuxian"
properties.Degr_EN: Weathering and peeling of some inscriptions
properties.Repa_CN: 2003 年拓片存档；2020 年安装防护栏杆
properties.Repa_EN: Rubbings were archived in 2003; protective railings were installed in 2020

properties.Prot_EN: Jiangsu Provincial Cultural Relics Protection Unit
properties.Hist_CN: 李根源隐居时题 “小隆中”，留存多方题刻
properties.Hist_EN: Li Gengen engraved "Xiaolongzhong" during his seclusion, with many inscriptions
properties.Relae_CN: 章太炎、于右任等 300 余人题刻
properties.Relae_EN: More than 300 inscriptions by Zhang Taiyan, Yu Youren, etc.
